sloka: तेषां तत्रोपविष्टानां तास्ताः सुमधुराः कथाः ।बभूवुः परमर्षीणां मध्यादित्यगते ऽहनि ।। ७.५१.६ ॥
transliteration: teṣāṁ tatropaviṣṭānāṁ tāstāḥ sumadhurāḥ kathāḥ ।babhūvuḥ paramarṣīṇāṁ madhyādityagate 'hani ।। 7.51.6 ॥

translations.english: As they sat there, various very pleasant conversations took place among the great sages during the midday.
